headline: SLG: no trade. An $0.85 FFO raise we cannot trace to its source; it looks like one-offs
reasoning: FFO guide $6.50-6.70 (was $5.60-5.90; consensus $5.32); Q3 FFO $1.59 vs $1.47; revenue missed.
GlobeNewswire blocked the fetch (403) and no 8-K is filed yet, so the driver of the raise is unverified.
Data limits tonight: Firecrawl is out of credits, and GlobeNewswire blocks direct requests. For releases not yet on EDGAR, the crew can only read Benzinga's summary.
Check later: SLG 1- and 5-day return; a big rally would mean the raise was recurring and the crew's caution cost something.
objections: Primary source unreachable; the driver of a $0.85 FFO raise against a $0.12 beat is unverified and likely non-recurring.
